dwp_take: A bunch of people gathered in Amsterdam last week to talk about AI agents actually doing useful work instead of destroying humanity, and somehow the frontier model vendors who would actually know what's happening couldn't be bothered to show up. dwp_take: Meta is building its own AI chip called Arke, due in 2027, designed to reduce inference costs and energy consumption while cutting dependence on third-party GPUs. title: Hackers Are Using Passkey Updates as a New Microsoft Phishing Hook

dwp_take: Criminals are now baiting employees with fake passkey and MFA update notifications to steal credentials and break into Microsoft 365 accounts. The irony is thick: we push passkeys as the more secure option, but users still can't tell a real update from a convincing fake, which means we're just giving hackers a shinier lure to cast.
